arStrings.szText: While {c_important}The Devourer{/c} is active, if a Non-Boss enemy's remaining Life becomes Poisoned, they die instantly.
While {c_important}The Devourer{/c} is active, your Poisoning effects have {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|%|]{/c} increased duration.
{c_important}The Devourer{/c} Heals you for {c_number}[SF_48*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_48]){/c} per second.
{c_important}The Devourer{/c} grants you {c_number}[SF_45 *100|%|]{/c} increased Thorns for {c_number}[SF_46]{/c} seconds.

As it emerges, {c_important}The Devourer{/c} launches {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} toxic globs that apply {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_POISON_DOT}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[SF_9]{/c} seconds wherever they land. Enemies affected by toxic globs also take {c_number}[{SF_39}*100|%x|]{/c} increased Poison Damage.

{c_important}The Devourer{/c} now only blasts enemies in a line once, dealing {c_number}{payload:SPIT_PAYLOAD_B_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage, before leaving. 

{c_important}The Devourer{/c} is now also a {c_important}Potency{/c} Skill and has a {c_number}{SF_40}{/c} second cooldown.

{c_important}The Devourer{/c} is also an {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill.

The Eagle Spirit aids {c_important}The Devourer{/c}, creating a Lightning Storm that Sparks enemies for {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_C_DOT}{/c} damage each second and makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}. Gain {c_number}[{SF_36}*100|%|]{/c} Movement Speed while {c_important}The Devourer{/c} is active.
